ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is circle A, point A is inside the circle as the center; on the left there is chord WX, and on the right there is chord XY. Segment AB from the center A is perpendicular to chord WX, with foot of perpendicular B, and beside it is marked 5x; segment AC from the center A is perpendicular to chord XY, with foot of perpendicular C, and beside it is marked 3x+4. The problem gives WX=XY=22. Reasoning: In the same circle, equal-length chords have equal distances to the center. Because WX=XY, the perpendicular distances from the center A to these two chords are equal, that is, AB=AC. Therefore 5x=3x+4, solving gives 2x=4, x=2. Thus AB=5x=5·2=10.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at A, with chords WX and XY. The marked right angles show AB is perpendicular to chord WX and AC is perpendicular to chord XY. The labels on these perpendicular distances are AB = 5x and AC = 3x + 4. From the text, WX = XY = 22. Use the circle theorem that congruent chords in the same circle are equidistant from the center, so AB = AC. Set 5x = 3x + 4, solve x = 2, then AB = 5x = 10.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是圆 A，A 点在圆内作为圆心；左侧有弦 WX，右侧有弦 XY。线段 AB 从圆心 A 垂直于弦 WX，垂足为 B，旁边标有 5x；线段 AC 从圆心 A 垂直于弦 XY，垂足为 C，旁边标有 3x+4。题目给出 WX=XY=22。推理：在同一个圆中，等长的弦到圆心的距离相等。因为 WX=XY，所以圆心 A 到这两条弦的垂直距离相等，即 AB=AC。因此 5x=3x+4，解得 2x=4，x=2。于是 AB=5x=5·2=10。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing AB perpendicular to WX at B and AC perpendicular to XY at C, with A the circle center and X on the circle. Since A is the center, AX is a radius. From the text, WX = XY = 22. A radius perpendicular to a chord bisects that chord, so because AB ⟂ WX, B is the midpoint of WX and BX = 11; similarly C is the midpoint of XY and CX = 11. Now compare right triangles ABX and ACX: they share hypotenuse AX, and have equal leg BX = CX. By HL congruence, AB = AC. Using the image labels, 5x = 3x + 4, so x = 2 and AB = 10.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 A 为圆心的圆，W、X、Y 在圆上，WX 和 XY 是两条弦。A 到弦 WX 作垂线，垂足为 B，图中 AB 标为 5x；A 到弦 XY 作垂线，垂足为 C，图中 AC 标为 3x+4。题目给出 WX=XY=22。推理：因为 A 是圆心，AX 是半径。圆心到弦的垂线会平分该弦，所以 B 是 WX 的中点，BX=22/2=11；C 是 XY 的中点，CX=22/2=11。直角三角形 ABX 和 ACX 共有斜边 AX，且一条直角边 BX=CX=11，因此由 HL 判定两三角形全等，所以 AB=AC。由图中标注 AB=5x，AC=3x+4，得到 5x=3x+4，解得 x=2。因此 AB=5x=10。
